title: The Last Veil
author: Kestrel Voss
blurb: Isandro Vasquez, an exiled storm-caller, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
